items.stem: Which TWO controls best support responsible use of AI in financial reporting? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Require human review and sign-off on AI-assisted figures
options.rationale: Correct: human accountability is essential for reported numbers.

options.text: Document data sources and model limitations
options.rationale: Correct: documentation supports auditability and trust.

options.text: Hide that AI was used from auditors
Disable all reconciliation checks to save time
